server.name: io.github.SidneyBissoli/medical-terminologies-mcp
server.description: Unified access to global medical terminologies: ICD-11, SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, MeSH, ATC, CID-10

environmentVariables.description: WHO ICD-11 API Client ID. Required only for ICD-11 tools (5 tools); the server starts without it and other terminologies (LOINC, RxNorm, MeSH, ATC, CID-10) work unauthenticated. Get credentials at https://icd.who.int/icdapi.
environmentVariables.name: WHO_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: WHO ICD-11 API Client Secret. Required only for ICD-11 tools.
environmentVariables.name: WHO_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: ICD-11 release to query (e.g. 2024-01, 2025-01). Optional; defaults to 2024-01.
environmentVariables.name: WHO_ICD11_RELEASE_ID

environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to register the 6 SNOMED-dependent tools (snomed_search, snomed_concept, snomed_hierarchy, snomed_descriptions, snomed_ecl, plus map_snomed_to_icd10). Disabled by default because the historical public IHTSDO Snowstorm endpoint was retired (HTTP 410 Gone). Requires SNOMED_BASE_URL pointing at a working self-hosted Snowstorm.
environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_SNOMED_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of a self-hosted Snowstorm instance (e.g. https://my-snowstorm.example.com/snowstorm/snomed-ct). Required only when ENABLE_SNOMED_TOOLS is true.
environmentVariables.name: SNOMED_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Accept-Language tag(s) for SNOMED responses (e.g. pt, pt-BR, es). Optional; defaults to 'en'. Composite values with q-weights depend on the upstream Snowstorm instance.
environmentVariables.name: SNOMED_LANGUAGE

environmentVariables.description: pino log level (debug, info, warn, error, fatal). Optional; defaults to 'info'. Logs go to stderr only — never stdout (which is the MCP stdio transport).
environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: Your Fleet API token. Get this from Fleet UI: My account > Get API token
environmentVariables.name: FLEET_API_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Enable read-only mode
environmentVariables.name: FLEET_READONLY

environmentVariables.description: Allow SELECT queries in read-only mode. This allows you to run live queries.
environmentVariables.name: FLEET_ALLOW_SELECT_QUERIES

environmentVariables.description: Verify SSL certificates when connecting to your Fleet instance.
environmentVariables.name: FLEET_VERIFY_SSL

server.name: io.github.Singlishman/kerdos-x402-mcp
server.description: Crypto market intelligence MCP — pay-per-tool-call in USDC on Base via the x402 protocol.

environmentVariables.description: User-supplied EVM private key on Base mainnet. Used solely to sign USDC `transferWithAuthorization` payment payloads via x402. Each tool call costs $0.01-$0.06 USDC.
environmentVariables.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional override of the Kerdos x402 endpoint base URL.
environmentVariables.name: KERDOS_X402_BASE_URL

server.name: io.github.Sintexer/jvmsrc
server.description: Gradle-accurate JVM classpath; fetch Java source, signatures, and class structure for agents.
server.title: JVM Source Lens

runtimeArguments.description: Install the package via npx without a confirmation prompt.
runtimeArguments.name: -y

packageArguments.description: Run the bundled MCP server (stdio transport).

environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated absolute paths; only these project roots are allowed.
environmentVariables.name: JVMSRC_ALLOWED_ROOTS

environmentVariables.description: Optional absolute path for resolution and decompile caches (default: OS cache dir).
environmentVariables.name: JVMSRC_CACHE_ROOT

environmentVariables.description: Optional absolute path for failure diagnostic logs.
environmentVariables.name: JVMSRC_LOG_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Max characters returned for full-file source (default 524288).
environmentVariables.name: JVMSRC_MAX_SOURCE_OUTPUT_CHARS

environmentVariables.description: Gradle resolution subprocess timeout in milliseconds.
environmentVariables.name: JVMSRC_GRADLE_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a custom CFR JAR for decompilation.
environmentVariables.name: JVMSRC_CFR_PATH
